title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' own state, read from the running record, shows what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. A single trade says nothing about a strategy.

## What the record contains

The live record is a paper record. Live starts are counted from 1 October 2026 for trend-daily-v005 and from 9 October 2026 for trend-daily-v006. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. That ATOM position exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

The record is short because the live starts are recent. The first signal came after the 10 October 2026 daily close, and the ATOM exit followed at the 18 October 2026 close. The ATOM result of 1.703, or −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip, is a single closed paper trade. It is a measurement of one trade, not a verdict on the rule that produced it.

## Open positions

At the 9 November 2026 snapshot, the open-position counts are:

- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v005: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006: 0 positions open on paper.

The signal record also lists a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Closed trades

The closed-trade counts and averages are:

- htf-rsi-v007: 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005: 6 closed trades so far, with an average −13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006: 7 closed trades so far, with an average −13.34% net per trade.

The ATOM exit at 1.703 on 18 October 2026, at −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip, sits inside those closed results. An average net per trade is a measurement across the closed trades in this record. It describes what happened in the recorded period. It does not establish what will happen next.

## Market filter and near-breakout names

For trend-daily-v005, the Bitcoin market filter is off. For trend-daily-v006, the Bitcoin market filter is off. In this snapshot, both of those engines show 0 positions open on paper. The filter state and the open-position count are both readings from the running record.

The record also lists which names are closest to a 20-day breakout:

- ZECUSDT is 8.28% below its high.
- TRXUSDT is 9.36% below its high.
- BNBUSDT is 9.82% below its high.

These distances are measurements from the 9 November 2026 read. They are not entry signals, and they do not predict a breakout.

## How to read this

The record updates continuously. The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-09T14:50:18.705Z. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

Because the testing record showed most trades losing and the average winner roughly +19%, a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The live record is paper, short, and unproven. It is inconclusive as a statement about future performance, and no single closed trade should be read as a verdict on a strategy.
